answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds force each participant to post collateral scaled to identity count, while a subgame-perfect slashing matrix imposes a penalty exceeding the stake for any Sybil detection, making the meadow of incentives hostile to duplication; the sparrow of attack thus incurs a strictly negative expected utility, as a verifiable delay primitive adds costly recomputation before any reward.
